message: 言霊

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fuaah~. I'm all sleepy-weepy......」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey now! You can't go to sleep yet, Lolotte-chan」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mumimumii...... Even so, Senpai, night patrols are bad for one's beauty, you know」

name: Misa
message: 「Gh...... Y-You might have a point there」

name: Synn
message: 「Should I bring over some homemade loofah toner tomorrow?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That'll be too late! We gotta perk Loro-chan right up now」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My butler told me that if you soak a wilted daikon radish in sugar water, it perks right back up」

name: Synn
message: 「Pushing yourself isn't good. Demons have been showing up more lately, so everyone's tired......」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, why don't you go take a quick nap in the infirmary?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If I go inside the school building this late at night, it'll be swarming with self-destructing spirits. Ka-booom!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way! Earthbound spirits are nasty specifically because they *can't* self-destruct, you know」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hold on. Cut it out with the out-of-season ghost stories」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh? Is Hiss scared of ghosts or somethin'?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I am not scared at all!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright! In that case, the Great Sage Paqy-sama will tell ya a story that'll wake ya right up」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Euu...... Please stop Mr. Panda, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh...... Well, if it ends up waking everyone up......」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-You might have a point there, Synn-kun, though......」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku...... Ria-chan gave her seal of approval. Brace yourselves and listen up」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeek」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ryuusei Town's right by the sea, right? Which means there's a river runnin' through it too」

name: Paqy
message: 「Humans are weak, so they desperately build embankments and floodgates to keep the water in check」

name: Paqy
message: 「This story is from, let's see...... a few decades ago, back when the river levee was first built」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hyaaaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa? Why are you gripping the cuff of my sleeve so tightly?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Shut up! I'm smoothing out the wrinkles for you!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The students at Ryuusei Academy went and started playing Kokkuri-san」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-You shouldn't do that out of mere curiosity, no-no!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, if you carelessly receive an oracle, something awful's gonna happen. Listen to this as a cautionary tale」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, if that's all it is, it's not scary at all」

name: Paqy
message: 「They started Kokkuri-san just for kicks, but before long, letters began lining up on their own, completely out of the students' control」

name: Paqy
message: 「TE-NI-HA-BO-U-RE-I-WO-KI-TE-NA-KU-Upon the hand, a wraith arrives and weeps--」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I-It's not scary, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「After that, the letters stopped lining up」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Phew, so it's over, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let's split into two groups and patrol, just like usual」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh...? Hey, wait, if you rearrange the order of those letters, doesn't it turn into a different sentence?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sharp for a soba noodle. In other words, it's like this」

name: Paqy
message: 「TE-I-BO-U-NI-KI-TE-HA-NA-WO-KU-RE-Come to the riverbank and give me flowers--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!? Now I'm too curious about what happens next to split up」

name: Ria
message: 「W-W-Who's the one asking for flowers?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, obviously it's--」

name: Everyone
message: 「Gyaaaaah--!?」
